newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Matra Hungary deal stands despite ruling - officials.
newsitem.headline: Matra Hungary deal stands despite ruling - officials.

text.p: French Matra Defense's $100 million missile deal with Hungary remains valid despite a Thursday ruling that the tender procedure was illegal, officials said on Friday.
"The Public Procurement Arbitration Commission (PPAC) does not have the power to cancel a signed contract, only a court could do that" Gyongyi Farkas, the commission's president told Reuters.
Matra Defense is a subsidiary of Lagadere Groupe.

The commission decided on Thursday that the Defence Ministry had contravened the Procurement law when it pursued talks exclusively with Matra after February 20, and fined the ministry's Procurement Office 20 million forints.
The Defence Ministry announced on Wednesday that Matra had won the deal to deliver three mobile batteries of Mistral air defence missiles by the end of the century.
The deal includes an offset deal to cover both investment in and purchases from Hungary's manufacturing sector equivalent to the purchase price, the first such offset deal Hungary has signed.
Farkas said that after establishing the procedure was illegal the job of the PPAC was completed.
"We do not plan any further steps, unless we (the commission) are taken to court," she said.
The ministry's head of procurement Jeno Kopasz expressed surprise at the decision and said on Thursday the ministry would appeal.
Hungary, which started the modernisation of its army with a view to NATO membership, announced the first tender for the anti-aircraft missiles last September.
The other bidders were Daimler-Benz, Sweden's Bofors, Bombardier unit Short Brothers of Northern Ireland and Hughes Electronics of the U.S.
Short Brothers' legal representative in Hungary Geza Patay said the company, which originally appealed to the PPAC, was studying the verdict before deciding what to do next.
Farkas said that all participants in the tender have the right to start legal procedures against the deal.
